_authoring.purpose: AI reactions to becoming a Milk Maid or receiving a milk-related curse.
_authoring.player_controls: How discovery, transformation and curse outcomes are described.
_authoring.contains: Separate conversion, existing-maid curse, chest curse and event-context text.
_authoring.perspective: The affected character owns the change; player reaction routes use private self-comments.
_authoring.boundary: A curse affecting an existing Milk Maid is not another conversion. Text does not cause conversion.

_help: Edit template text or replace a template with a string array. Keep the documented placeholders. Use MCM Reload Narration JSON after saving.

narrate_milkmaid_created_1.template: {actor} has become a Milk Maid and can now produce milk. React in her own voice to discovering this ability.

narrate_forced_milk_maid_conversion_1.template: {conversion} React as {actor} to the transformation. Its cause is unspecified; do not invent a drink.

milkmaidCreatedMessage.template: {actor} has become a Milk Maid! Her breasts now feel pleasantly heavy, full, and faintly thrilling.

narrate_milk_maid_curse_1.template: {conversion} React as {actor}, an existing Milk Maid, to the added milk. This is not a new conversion or a drink.

narrate_chest_milk_maid_curse_1.template: A curse from a {chest_kind} affected {actor}. {outcome} React as {actor} to the chest's enchantment. Milk added: {milk_added}; do not recite numbers or invent a drink, loot, or another conversion.
